content.title: Suspended Accident Repair | Traceable Reconstruction Before Global Resumption
content.summary: Establish an intact object and normally moving environment, then let one attributable accident separate the object into visible components while suspending every surrounding layer. Keep one specialist mobile, recover and rebuild the same components in a traceable order, complete the handoff, and resume the environment once.

quick_start.input_format: intact object and active environment baseline + one accident separates components and suspends the world + one mobile specialist + traceable same-component recovery and reconstruction + completed handoff + single global resumption
quick_start.recommended_input: Inside an orbital greenhouse laboratory, a pressure jolt separates one ceramic seed capsule into two shell halves, clear nutrient gel, and three dark seeds while technicians, mist, and tools freeze. One adult containment engineer alone gathers the same components, rebuilds the capsule in a sterile cradle, returns it to an adult botanist, and releases the whole laboratory once.
required_anchors: Show a complete target object and at least two independent environmental motion classes before the accident.
Use one visible accident to create maximum disorder and suspend all non-specialist motion.
Recover separated component families in traceable source-to-destination order and rebuild the same object.
Complete one service handoff before one global resumption in the original geography.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish an intact object and normally moving environment, then let one attributable accident separate the object into visible components while suspending every surrounding layer. Keep one specialist mobile, recover and rebuild the same components in a traceable order, complete the handoff, and resume the environment once.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish a normally active environment and one complete target object. Use one attributable accident to separate the object into several visible component families at maximum disorder while suspending all surrounding motion. Keep one clearly defined specialist as the only mobile exception; make the specialist recover the same components in a traceable order, reconstruct the object without replacing it, complete one service transfer, then resume the environment exactly once. The reusable mechanism is baseline object, accident suspension, sole repair agent, traceable component recovery, restored handoff and terminal resumption—not the source bar, couple, cocktail, ice, orange peel, bartender likeness, wardrobe, camera path, watermark, creator identity or model label.

invariants.rule: Show a complete target object and at least two independent environmental motion classes before the accident.
invariants.purpose: Creates falsifiable baselines for both object integrity and world motion.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting after the break makes neither damage nor suspension provable.

invariants.rule: Use one visible accident to create maximum disorder and suspend all non-specialist motion.
invariants.purpose: Gives the frozen repair interval one attributable cause.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated cuts or multiple causes weaken the event topology.

invariants.rule: Keep exactly one clearly defined specialist mobile while all other people and loose components remain suspended.
invariants.purpose: Makes the repair agent and state rule unambiguous.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple active agents turn the scene into ordinary teamwork.

invariants.rule: Recover separated component families in traceable source-to-destination order and rebuild the same object.
invariants.purpose: Proves repair rather than replacement or unexplained magic.
invariants.ablation_failure: A new object appearing without component continuity breaks the mechanism.

invariants.rule: Complete one service handoff before one global resumption in the original geography.
invariants.purpose: Provides a countable terminal proof that the repair succeeded.
invariants.ablation_failure: Resuming early or ending before transfer leaves the causal chain open.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source bar interior, counter, crowd arrangement and service geography
the source couple, bartender likeness, wardrobe, gestures and relationship staging
the source cocktail, vessel, liquid, ice, orange peel and exact reconstruction choreography
the source collision design, frozen poses, camera orbit, macro path, timing and color treatment
the source creator identity, Seedance 2.5 claim, platform overlay, watermark and visible branding
